name: PropagateReshape
scope: The tensor-dialect propagate-reshape pass itself: its func::FuncOp-level skip gates, the option-gated pattern set (PropagateCollapseDown / PropagateExpandUp / SwapCollapseExpand / PropagateNearEndExpandDown and the memref companions), all its pipeline placements including conditional ones, and its legality gates. Excludes the MemRef-Transforms PropagateReshape directory's own pass definitions, FlattenOps internals, and downstream lowering.

why_this_subject: Phase T3 multi-pass system story: propagate-reshape is a conditional/parallel-branch participant in the regbase pipeline story. It decides tensor shapes (which dims are materialized vs unit) before FlattenOps and vectorization, its option gates (forRegbased/forHIVM/skipScope) encode the A3-vs-A5 (membase-vs-regbase) split, and two of its five regbase-story placements run only when the target is NOT reg-based — exactly the kind of placement condition the system story must record honestly.
